Hi Marcus,

Your last message came through as just a single letter, so I think it may have sent by accident. If you meant to ask something, write it back here and I'll pick it up.

In the meantime, everything on your side is set. Georges approved the return for the BS-2 on Shop···· and UPS has emailed you the prepaid label, tracking ····. Worth a look in your junk folder if it isn't in the inbox. Pack the unit with the loop closed, write Shop···· on the outside of the box, and drop it at any UPS point.

I'll keep an eye on it once it's moving.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Have you guys seen any updates on the miner? I did see it came to its destination 3 days ago, and I chose option b, putting the value on to a new minee.

Skickat från Outlook för Android<https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg>

Hi Marcus,

Yes, that's all come through. Your return is settled, and option b is done: 390 USD is sitting as store credit on your account under (email hidden), put there on October 28. You'll see it as an available balance at checkout when you're logged in, and it comes off the total of whatever you order next. Nothing expires on it.

So the BS-2 side of this is closed. Nothing more to send back and nothing owed either way.

If you tell me which miner you're leaning towards, I'll check the live stock for Sweden and tell you plainly whether it ships now or is a pre-order with a date, before you spend the credit. You were looking at the Thor P2 and the DC02 earlier, so I'm happy to compare those two against what the credit covers.

Sorry again for the trouble with the pump.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
